title: Projects
text:
Worked on a probability and statistics application project using real-estate datasets. I preprocessed public data, performed feature selection, and developed multiple prediction models including XGBoost, Random Forest, Lasso, Polynomial Regression, and Linear Regression. Among these models, XGBoost achieved the best performance based on RMSE. :contentReferenceoaicite:7



Studied the Mean Value Theorem and its connections to other major results in calculus. The project examined applications such as solving limits, proving constancy of functions, and approximating functions through Taylor series. This work later developed into a publication. :contentReferenceoaicite:8



Developed a puzzle game in Python inspired by Rodent’s Revenge. I independently designed the gameplay: raccoons attempt to reach garbage cans, while the player must stop them by strategically placing recycling bins to trap them. :contentReferenceoaicite:9



Collaborated on a turn-based strategy video game in Java inspired by Civilization VI. The project involved implementing player combat, strategic point control, and win conditions based on holding positions for multiple turns. I also served as project leader, helping coordinate coding tasks, refine gameplay details, and organize team meetings and deadlines. :contentReferenceoaicite:10



Wu, S. Proof and Application of the Mean Value Theorem.
Highlights in Science, Engineering and Technology, 2023, 72: 565–571. :contentReferenceoaicite:11
